name: Standard adult CABG
desc: 75 kg, normal heart function. The case from the lab video.

name: Small elderly woman with anemia
desc: 52 kg, hematocrit 30%. Hemodilution pushes oxygen delivery below target.

name: Large adult
desc: 125 kg. High flow demand tests venous drainage and pump head.

name: Low ejection fraction
desc: Ischemic cardiomyopathy, EF about 20%. Hard to wean without inotrope.

name: Chronic kidney disease
desc: Poor potassium clearance. Cardioplegia load causes hyperkalemia.

name: Heparin resistance
desc: Standard heparin dose leaves the clotting time too short for bypass.

name: Severe aortic insufficiency
desc: Leaky aortic valve. Antegrade cardioplegia runs into the ventricle instead of the coronaries.

name: Vasoplegia
desc: Septic-type low vascular tone. Pressure sags on bypass and needs vasopressor.

name: Long-standing hypertension
desc: Stiff, high-resistance circulation. Pressure runs high and flow falls for a given pump speed.

name: Jehovah's Witness (no transfusion)
desc: 60 kg, declines blood products. Oxygen delivery must be protected without red cells.
